zh: v0.0.1 到 v0.0.3 是早期预览。v0.1.0 是第一个公开 Beta，覆盖从导入旧对话、分派任务到群组协作和跨设备查看进度的日常流程。
切换窗口后，桌面灵动岛仍会展示后台 Bot 的任务进度、当前步骤和执行位置。可以在设置里选择显示内容。
连接 Pi Bot Browser 扩展后，Pi 可在你常用的浏览器里操作网页和标签页。新增扩展检测、安装指引和连接状态，修复 Chrome 商店链接及商店版扩展连接。也可选择只用 Bot 浏览器。
导入旧对话时，可选择 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 导出文件，或本机检测到的 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 与 Antigravity。支持预览、搜索、取消、继续原话题和整批撤销。保留来源与时间，超长消息可作为附件查看。
导入时可分别查看记忆、自定义指令及项目规则，再决定保存位置或确认文件差异。也可按次授权使用配置好的模型从历史对话提炼记忆。
纠正 Bot 后，可在回复下面看到当轮记住了什么并撤销。记忆按类型整理，临时决定可以设有效期，项目事实可提议写入项目说明。
记忆可手动整理，也可在电脑空闲时整理。它可以合并重复项并检测过期记忆。可查看、审核或撤销变动。模型、预算和失败原因更清楚，单独的记忆模型不可用时可回退。
让默认的 Pi 查看设置、管理 Bot 和群组、检查卡住的任务或分派工作。需要确认的操作有审批卡。分派时可按任务难度选模型，可用模型变化时能恢复。
群组计划会更清楚地显示步骤、进度和交付件。在聊天或「等你处理」查看重试、跳过、改派等选项，工作区审批完成后可继续。群聊默认自动来回 8 次，可设为 1 到 10 次，达到上限还可继续同一份计划。
新增「一人公司」和内容创作相关的内置群组模板。对外发送仍要确认。支持 Antigravity CLI 作为外部 Agent，并改善外部 Agent 在群聊和执行审批中的体验。
可独立为话题和群步骤选模型，刷新供应商和自定义地址的模型列表更方便。检测到本机 Magpie 时会提供接入入口。按 Bot 切换供应商前会先确认。内核升级到 Pi 1.6.0。
生图支持批量生成、比较和复用图片。新增 Seedream、通义万相及 Qwen Image、Grok Imagine、ComfyUI 等接入，并扩展 ChatGPT 计划和兼容接口的模型与图片返回支持。
支持按次审批的后台视频生成，在聊天里直接播放交付的视频和音频。可为每个 Bot 设默认视频模型，审批卡也可换模型。支持 Google、OpenAI、OpenRouter 和多种自定义视频接口。
新增自媒体工作台和生图灵感库。可准备脚本和分镜，或在本地模板库查找版式、构图及风格。非英文搜索词可尝试自动翻译，结果可在工具步骤查看。
输入 / 可选当前 Bot 可用的技能、应用和 MCP，另有本地 /帮助。可从一个输入框粘贴 MCP 配置、命令或网址并先预览。连接页面简化授权与配置，修复代理网络下 GitHub 等插件访问公网 API。
用表单建技能、一键准备运行环境。缺少 Python、Node、Git 或办公工具时有指引。本地文档文件夹可接入知识库，并按 Bot 授权。数据位置、备份、导入和清理入口更清楚。
Android 可看群组进度、处理待决定的步骤和审批。设备页可手动检查、下载并交给系统安装器更新，在线时至多每天自动检查一次。从 v0.0.3 升级需先从官网下载安装包。
Runner 在 macOS 和 Windows 跟随系统代理或 PAC，Linux 可显式配置代理。改善配对、重连和隔离诊断。Linux 新增适配 Ubuntu AppArmor 的桌面 .deb，并改善文件读取、回收站和权限提示。
Windows 支持更多非 C 盘和映射盘路径，合规只读命令减少打扰，首次启用 YOLO 会说明隔离范围。电脑操作的审批和失败提示更清楚。沙箱里的插件访问新站点前会询问。加固 macOS 技能隔离和外部 Agent 授权。
聊天字号可选三档。大量话题滚动更轻快。历史中的交付文件和图片更完整，上下文整理提示自动收起。改善后台启动、重复发消息、群组状态和更新下载中断后的提示。
en: Versions 0.0.1 through 0.0.3 were early previews. Version 0.1.0 is the first public beta, connecting conversation import, task assignment, group collaboration and progress across devices.
Live Island shows background Bot progress, the current step and where work is running while you switch windows. Choose what it displays in Settings.

Connect Pi Bot Browser to use pages and tabs in your own browser. The app detects the extension and shows setup guidance and connection status. This release fixes the Chrome Web Store link and connection. You can still choose the built-in browser.

Import ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini exports, or detected Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and Antigravity sessions. Preview, search, cancel, continue in the imported topic or undo a batch. Source and dates are retained, and long messages can open as attachments.

Review imported memories, custom instructions and project rules separately before choosing where to save them or approving a file diff. You can also approve model-assisted memory extraction from imported conversations for a specific import.

Corrections can show a memory confirmation with Undo under the reply. Memories are organized by type, temporary decisions can expire, and project facts can become suggested additions to project notes.

Run memory cleanup manually or let it run while the computer is idle to merge duplicates and find expired memories. Review or undo changes. Model, budget and failure details are clearer, with fallback when the selected memory model is unavailable.

Ask the default Pi in chat to view settings, manage Bots and groups, diagnose stuck work or assign tasks. Actions that require approval show a card. Pi can select a model by task difficulty and recover when a model becomes unavailable.

Group plans show clearer briefs, progress and outputs. Review choices such as retry, skip and reassign in chat or the inbox. Workspace approvals keep work waiting. Groups default to 8 automatic rounds, configurable from 1 to 10, and can continue the same plan after the limit.

Try new built-in group templates for a one-person company and content creation. External sends still require approval. Antigravity CLI is supported as an external agent, with improvements to external agents in group chats and approvals.

Choose separate models for a topic or group step and refresh provider or custom catalogs more easily. Magpie setup appears when its local gateway is detected. Provider switches for selected Bots ask for confirmation. The agent kernel moves to pi 1.6.0.

Generate, compare and reuse batches of images. This release adds integrations for Seedream, Wanx and Qwen Image, Grok Imagine and ComfyUI, and broadens model and image-result support for ChatGPT plans and compatible APIs.

Generate video in approved background jobs and play video or audio in chat. Set a default video model per Bot and switch eligible models on the approval card. Supported providers include Google, OpenAI, OpenRouter and several custom video APIs.

Media Desk and Image Inspiration Library are new. Prepare scripts and storyboards or search locally bundled layout, composition and style templates. Non-English search queries can be translated automatically, with the result visible in tool details.

Type / to choose an available skill, app or MCP connection, with built-in /help. Paste MCP config, a command or a URL into one preview form. Connection setup and access are clearer, and plugins such as GitHub can reach public APIs on proxy networks.

Create skills with a form and prepare their runtime. Get guidance when Python, Node, Git or office tools are missing. Connect local document folders to a knowledge library and choose which Bots can use it. Data locations, backups, imports and cleanup are clearer.

Android shows group progress and lets you resolve held steps or approvals. Check for updates manually on Devices or download and open the system installer. Automatic checks run at most daily while online. Upgrade from v0.0.3 using the website APK first.

Runner follows system proxy or PAC on macOS and Windows and supports configured proxies on Linux. Pairing, reconnection and isolation diagnostics improve. Linux adds a desktop .deb for Ubuntu AppArmor and improves file reads, trash handling and permission messages.

Windows handles more drive paths and prompts less for eligible read-only commands. First-use YOLO explains isolation. Computer-use approvals and errors are clearer. Sandboxed plugins ask before visiting new sites. macOS skill isolation and external agent approvals are improved.

Choose from three chat text sizes and scroll large topic lists more smoothly. History keeps work files and images more reliably, and the context cleanup notice dismisses itself. Startup, queued messages, group status and interrupted update downloads are clearer.
